name: Long Term Work Permit (Work Permit for Non-Citizen Skilled Contracted Workers, "Time Post")

requirements.blocker_text: Valid employment contract with a locally registered Fiji company (or conversion from a Short Term Work Permit, or a spousal-basis application).

Employer must advertise the position and submit a complete, tabulated list of local applicants shortlisted, with qualifications/experience and reasons for rejection -- unless the role is a certified family business, government contract, or intra-company secondment.

evidence_required.document: Employer's job advertisement + tabulated local-applicant rejection list

outcome.duration_length: 1 to 3 years, renewable via extension category

sources.title: Department of Immigration, Fiji -- Long Term Work Permit: requires valid employment contract with a locally registered company, 1-3 years validity, fee FJD 650.05 primary / FJD 185 per dependent, excludes holders of study/residence/investor/visitor permits from direct eligibility

Department of Immigration, Fiji -- Work Permit for Non-Citizen Skilled Contracted Workers ('Time Post'), Immigration Act 2003 s.9(2)(c): mandatory advertising and itemized local-applicant rejection list, exemptions for certified family business/government contract/intra-company secondment, FIRCA compliance certificate required for extension

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both hard requirements are tier-1 Department of Immigration sourced. GAP DISCLOSED, NOT FABRICATED: the brief asked about a 'Ministry of Employment unemployment certificate' clearance step -- this could not be verified in any tier-1/2 source under that terminology. What IS confirmed at tier-1 is a functionally equivalent labour-market test administered directly by the Department of Immigration itself (mandatory advertising plus a documented rejection list), not a separate Ministry of Employment certificate -- treat the 'unemployment certificate' phrasing as unconfirmed/possibly outdated. A separate Short Term Work Permit exists (up to 1 year, non-renewable as short-term, no dependents, urgently-needed overseas workers) and converts into this route -- disclosed rather than modeled as its own file. citizenship_after_months (96) reflects the transitional 8-of-10-year naturalisation rule from fj_citizenship_naturalisation.json, not independently sourced here.
